# Set up environment
```{r}
library(qqman)
library(circilize)
library(VennDiagram)
```

# SNP-GWAS
```{r}
data <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/SNPGWAS_Fasttree_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)

# Extract "BP" from the first column by splitting at "_"
positions <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(data[[1]]), "_"), function(x) x[2])

# Extract p-value from the 4th column
pvals <- data[[4]]

# Calculate -log10(p)
logp <- -log10(pvals)

# Construct final data frame
out_df <- data.frame(
  CHR = 1,
  SNP = ".",
  BP = as.numeric(positions),
  minLOG10P = logp,
  log10p = logp,
  r2 = 0
)

# Add header
header <- c("CHR", "SNP", "BP", "minLOG10(P)", "log10(p)", "r^2")
colnames(out_df) <- header

manhattan(
  out_df,
  chr = "CHR",
  bp = "BP",
  p = "minLOG10(P)",  # Use the column with -log10(p-values)
  snp = "SNP",
  main = "Manhattan Plot of SNP-GWAS\n Population Structure Controlled w/: FastTree (LMM)",
  col = c("skyblue", "orange"),  # Customize colors as desired
  genomewideline = -log10(5e-8),  # Set a genome-wide significance line if desired
  suggestiveline = -log10(1e-5)   # Set a suggestive significance line if needed
)
```

# Calculate -log10(p)

# Get significance threshold
